headers_that_matter.Set-Cookie: nightlio_token=<JWT>; Expires=<TS>; Max-Age=3600; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax

notes: Credential-free self-host branch: valid only while OIDC is unconfigured (enable_oidc=false); with OIDC configured the same request is 403 {"error": "Credentials required"}.
user.id is the autoincrement id of the seeded default self-host user (1 on a fresh database).

Set-Cookie: Max-Age mirrors JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES (3600); Secure is ABSENT because the request arrived over plain HTTP (request.is_secure false and TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS unset). Over HTTPS (or trusted X-Forwarded-Proto: https) the same cookie gains '; Secure'.
Rate limited: 30 requests/minute per client -> 429 beyond that.
